other_failure_modes.name: Inefficient Sparse-to-Dense Conversion
other_failure_modes.description: The agent indexes a large CSR sparse matrix with a random permutation array and converts it to a dense array batch-by-batch. This non-contiguous indexing and repeated dense conversion of 75,000 features is extremely slow and memory-intensive, leading to a computational bottleneck and execution timeout.

summary: The agent implements a deep MLP on top of TF-IDF and dense linguistic features, strictly avoiding data leakage by properly splitting the data before scaling and vectorizing. However, the model evaluates a stochastic architecture exactly once (FM14) and relies on a single metric (FM15). Most critically, the training loop performs random non-contiguous row indexing on a large CSR matrix and converts 75,000 sparse features to dense arrays per batch, resulting in massive computational overhead and a 2-hour execution timeout.
